content.text: Definition of Done and Release Readiness

A Jira version is READY only when every assigned feature story meets its acceptance criteria and is Done; each story's linked QA subtask has passed and contains test evidence; no open blocking bug or unresolved dependency remains; the release-candidate unit and integration tests pass; and release notes, operational impact, and a rollback or feature-flag-off plan have been reviewed.
All assigned feature stories are Done.
Each linked QA subtask is Done and contains reproducible evidence.
No open blocking bugs or unresolved dependency links remain.
Unit and integration tests pass on the release candidate.
Release notes, operational impact, and rollback or flag-off plan are reviewed.
Controlled flags are mapped to the implementation story and QA subtask and remain off until both Jira issues are Done.
Keep this checklist in sync with docs/definition-of-done.md. Sprint and release status must reflect Jira readbacks and actual work; do not mark work Done solely because a local code path exists.
